title: SyncTuningTable
description: Shape of data/movement/sync-tuning.json: the networking values that are FELT, kept out of code literals so that tuning 'does movement feel right' never means editing Rust or C#. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: tick_hz (a world constant on the worlds row - I-19 - and a third copy would make 'which one is true' a judgement call), the quantisation scales and integer ranges (ADR-0009), and the integrator identity and the ban on transcendental functions (ADR-0010). Those are laws, not tunables: putting them in data would let someone change a value and have nothing happen, which is worse than not having it. 단위 접미사 규약: 모든 수치 필드 이름이 단위로 끝난다 (_m, _mps, _mps2, _deg_s, _deg_s2, _ms, _s, _hz, _t, _ly, _kib_s, _ticks). 스키마가 모든 필드를 명시 선언하므로 접미사는 propertyNames 패턴이 아니라 이 선언 자체가 강제한다. 데이터 테이블은 와이어 계약과 달리 실수(SI 단위)를 쓴다 (ADR-0009 section 2의 명시적 예외). 이 값들은 와이어를 왕복하지 않고 기동 시 한 번 읽히며, 튜닝하는 사람이 읽을 수 있어야 한다. 서버 내부 상태도 같은 SI f64라 변환이 없다.

snapshot_hz.description: Full snapshots per second. MUST divide tick_hz exactly; the server derives snapshot_interval_ticks = tick_hz / snapshot_hz and refuses to start otherwise. p1-01 uses 10: at 31 ships a 20 Hz stream is about 340 KiB/s per session, which the budget below already forbids.

egress_budget_kib_s_per_session.description: The measured per-session snapshot stream must stay under this. It is the rule that decided snapshot_hz, and it is written down so nobody has to re-derive it later.

client_send_hz.description: One control input per tick. The client's prediction advances exactly once per input it sends.

carry_forward_max_ticks.description: How long the server keeps applying the last input when none arrives. Zero would turn one late packet into a hiccup; unbounded would let a disconnected ship accelerate forever.

rate_limit_hz.description: Sustained input rate above which commands are rejected with RATE_LIMITED. Rejection, never silent discard (I-22).

protocol_violation_hz.description: Rate above which the session's protocol violation budget is charged (ADR-0006 section 6).

remote_interp_delay_ms.description: How far in the past other ships are drawn. Must be at least one snapshot interval or the buffer runs dry every frame.

remote_extrapolate_max_ms.description: How long a missing snapshot may be extrapolated from the last velocity before the ship is simply held still. Extrapolating further invents facts.

reconcile_ignore_threshold_m.description: Below this the render offset is not touched at all. It exists because the wire quantises position to 1 mm, so a perfectly correct client still sees up to sqrt(3)/2 mm of disagreement every single snapshot; without this band the correction machinery would run forever on noise. Keep it above 0.002 and far below the smooth threshold.

reconcile_smooth_threshold_m.description: Up to this error the simulation snaps but the render offset decays smoothly.

reconcile_hard_snap_threshold_m.description: Above this the render jumps and a counter is incremented. It is a bug signal, not a feel setting: on a local link with the same integrator on both sides it should never fire.
